description.en: A foil dropdown that pops the selected capsule out of its pocket and into the trigger.
description.zh: 选中一行，胶囊会弹出药槽并飞进顶部，铝箔留下撕开的空槽。

keywords: 胶囊 药板 铝箔 弹出 下拉菜单 筛选 状态 pill capsule foil blister pack dropdown filter

discovery.caveat: 详情演示使用原版 HTML。六框架移植版通过 onValueChange 连接实际数据，可配置数量、默认状态、收起行为和音效。

source.implementation: Six LeiBox framework ports use an independent DOM and CSS implementation. The website demo runs the supplied HTML and its original assets and animation code.
source.license: No independent redistribution license was verified for the supplied HTML and artwork. The framework packages use independent CSS materials and retain the Lucide license notice.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Select a capsule to change the filter. Click the trigger to open or close the menu.
instructions.zh: 点选胶囊切换筛选，点击顶部展开或收起菜单。
